analysis: The supplied units are head-side excerpts of docs/developer/test.md (lines 1382-2307), which is documentation only. The file_changes patch shows the header date bump, SDK 27 release qualification wording (sharded qualify-sdk-shard jobs plus an aggregate qualify-sdk audit), one added test script line (test-provider-cluster-runtime-models.py), and some further edits near head lines 1331-1362 that are truncated in the excerpt. The displayed units cover mostly unchanged surrounding test guidance (Flint, GLM cluster, GPT-OSS, MiMo, prefix tenant partition, SSD prefix record encoding checks). I found no executable code, no new endpoints, and no change to key custody, attestation, App Attest authorization, prefix-cache crypto or TTL behavior. The T-041 threat (prefix cache and at-rest posture) is described in the doc only as test guidance; nothing here loosens the production gate, TTL, HMAC lookup tags or tenant scoping. The test-doc statements that the checks do not grant anything and do not establish hardware or production qualification are consistent with the threat model's no-overclaim posture (T-056, T-058). The release shard change only affects CI and qualification process described in docs; I could not verify the actual workflow or scripts/provider-test-shards.py, so whether the aggregate audit still blocks signing on any skipped shard is an unverified contract outside the supplied evidence. The patch excerpt is truncated, so changes after roughly line 1346 were not fully visible; nothing in the visible text indicates a security regression. No finding is warranted.
